items.title: 13.3.1 Types of Animals on the basis of Heat Source (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of ectotherms and endotherms (PDF 7).

blocks.text: Ectotherms woh janwar hain jo apne jism ki zyada tar hararat bahar ke zariye (external sources, jaise dhoop) se lete hain. In ka andar ka darja-e-hararat aam taur par aas paas ke darja-e-hararat ke saath upar neeche hota rehta hai. Zyada tar invertebrates ectotherms hain. Vertebrates mein machhliyan (fishes), amphibians (jaise mendak) aur reptiles (jaise chhipkali, saanp) ectotherms hain. Ectotherms mein metabolism ki raftar bohat kam hoti hai. Yeh itni hararat paida nahin kar sakte ke apne jism ka darja-e-hararat barha kar qaim rakh saken, is liye yeh mahol ki hararat par bharosa karte hain. Ectotherms apne rawayye (behavior) se darja-e-hararat qaboo karte hain. Agar inhen bohat thand lage to yeh dhoop sekte hain (radiation se hararat) ya garam patthar par baith jate hain (conduction se hararat). Agar bohat garmi ho to yeh saya dhoondte hain ya thandi zameen mein bil (burrow) bana lete hain. Bohat thande ilaqon mein yeh sab se thande mahinon mein soi hui (dormant) halat mein chale jate hain.

Endotherms apne jism ki zyada tar hararat andar ke metabolism se khud paida karte hain. Yeh apne jism ka darja-e-hararat kafi had tak ek jaisa rakhte hain, jo aksar mahol se zyada hota hai. Birds aur mammals endotherms hain. Thand barhne par yeh kaampte (shiver karte) hain (muscles ka sukarna) ya hararat ke liye brown adipose tissue (bhoori charbi) jalate hain. Zyada tar endotherms mein hararat rokne ke liye insulation hoti hai, jaise baal, par (feathers) ya charbi.

blocks.prompt: Jism ki hararat ke maakhaz ki bunyad par janwaron ki darja-bandi kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Ectotherms mahol se hararat lete aur rawayye se qaboo karte (machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles, zyada tar invertebrates); endotherms metabolism se hararat banate aur insulation se rakhte (parinde, mammals).

items: Ectotherms: hararat bahar se; metabolism kam; dhoop sekna, saya dhoondna jaisa rawayya; machhliyan, amphibians, reptiles, zyada tar invertebrates.
Endotherms: hararat andar ke metabolism se; mustaqil darja-e-hararat; kaampna, brown adipose tissue, insulation; birds aur mammals.
